name: What factors should I consider when choosing a contractor for an ADU conversion in cities like Irvine or Yorba Linda?

mainEntity.name: What factors should I consider when choosing a contractor for an ADU conversion in cities like Irvine or Yorba Linda?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor for an ADU conversion in areas like Irvine or Yorba Linda, consider their experience with similar projects and their familiarity with local permitting requirements. Look for a licensed and insured contractor with a strong portfolio and positive client references. Ask about their communication style, project management approach, and how they handle potential delays or unexpected issues. A reliable contractor will provide a detailed proposal, transparent pricing, and a clear timeline for the project.
acceptedAnswer.description: When choosing a contractor, prioritize experience with ADU conversions, local permitting knowledge, licensing, insurance, and clear communication.
